schema.content:
Table "Course" {
  "CID" TEXT [pk]
  "CName" TEXT
  "Credits" INTEGER
  "Instructor" INTEGER
  "Days" TEXT
  "Hours" TEXT
  "DNO" INTEGER
}

Table "Department" {
  "DNO" INTEGER [pk]
  "Division" TEXT
  "DName" TEXT
  "Room" TEXT
  "Building" TEXT
  "DPhone" INTEGER
}

Table "Enrolled_in" {
  "StuID" INTEGER
  "CID" TEXT
  "Grade" TEXT
}

Table "Faculty" {
  "FacID" INTEGER [pk]
  "Lname" TEXT
  "Fname" TEXT
  "Rank" TEXT
  "Sex" TEXT
  "Phone" INTEGER
  "Room" TEXT
  "Building" TEXT
}

Table "Gradeconversion" {
  "lettergrade" TEXT [pk]
  "gradepoint" REAL
}

Table "Member_of" {
  "FacID" INTEGER
  "DNO" INTEGER
  "Appt_Type" TEXT
}

Table "Minor_in" {
  "StuID" INTEGER
  "DNO" INTEGER
}

Table "Student" {
  "StuID" INTEGER [pk]
  "LName" TEXT
  "Fname" TEXT
  "Age" INTEGER
  "Sex" TEXT
  "Major" INTEGER
  "Advisor" INTEGER
  "city_code" TEXT
}



Ref: "Member_of"."DNO" > "Department"."DNO"

Ref: "Member_of"."FacID" > "Faculty"."FacID"

Ref: "Course"."DNO" > "Department"."DNO"

Ref: "Course"."Instructor" > "Faculty"."FacID"

Ref: "Minor_in"."DNO" > "Department"."DNO"

Ref: "Minor_in"."StuID" > "Student"."StuID"

Ref: "Enrolled_in"."Grade" > "Gradeconversion"."lettergrade"

Ref: "Enrolled_in"."CID" > "Course"."CID"

Ref: "Enrolled_in"."StuID" > "Student"."StuID"
